title: Native Android Release Journeys and Interaction Verification Matrix

journeys.name: Sign-in and Two-Account Switching Isolation
journeys.verification: Account A signs in, transitions session generation; Account B signs in and switches session state cleanly without cross-account state leakage.

journeys.name: Local Storage Recovery and Create/Save/Reopen
journeys.verification: Entity draft is preserved on edits, persists across cancellations, and saves with exact entity type and title.

journeys.name: Offline Restart and Cold Launch Operability
journeys.verification: App cold starts offline cleanly; renders TodayView, routines, and task sections without throwing unhandled network exceptions.

journeys.name: Notification Channels and Inexact Scheduling
journeys.verification: NotificationChannels 'reminders' (HIGH/PRIVATE) and 'updates' (DEFAULT/Silent) configured; restricted USE_EXACT_ALARM excluded.

journeys.name: Microphone Behavior and Accessible Fallback
journeys.verification: Denied microphone permission provides 100% accessible text typing fallback; local cancellation invokes discardRecordingAsync() with zero network/DB requests.

journeys.name: Landscape Orientation and Large Text Scaling
journeys.verification: Header buttons and bottom navigation tabs enforce >= 48dp touch targets and allowFontScaling={true} for accessibility.

journeys.name: Hardware Back Button Navigation Stack
journeys.verification: Back button unwinds navigation in priority: topmost modal -> nested settings -> settings hub -> subview -> today -> exit/minimize.

journeys.name: TalkBack Accessibility Tree and Focus Return Contracts
journeys.verification: accessibilityRole='alert' set on validation errors, accessibilityViewIsModal={true} set on modal sheets, accessible close buttons verified.
